## Summary

Both `release.yml` and `auto-release.yml` were missing `registry-url: 'https://registry.npmjs.org'` in their `setup-node` steps. Without it, npm has no registry context to exchange the GitHub OIDC token against and returns `ENEEDAUTH`.

## Test plan

- [ ] After merge: dispatch `release.yml` on `v0.4.2` — should publish successfully
